insight: Node.js 25.8 crypto API missing createCertificate and createSelfSignedSubject - use openssl CLI instead for certificate generation
@fastify/websocket doesn't export Socket type - use simple interface { remoteAddress?: string } for connection validation instead

The mid-panel widget system allows plugins to contribute UI elements to a horizontal bar in the TUI. Each widget needs an id, label, and getContent() function. Multiple widgets are rendered side-by-side with " │ " separators. The system is extensible - any plugin can offer a widget.

Phase 3.3 knowledge registry implementation went smoothly. The coordinator-beacon sync pattern (push/pull with upsert) is consistent with the existing persona/skill sync pattern, making integration straightforward.

The macros loader had no error handling around parseMacroFile() — any malformed .macro file would crash the entire agent during plugin initialization. The fix was to wrap the call in try-catch and log a warning, which is a pattern that should be applied more broadly across the plugin system.

The executeMacro function in the macros plugin had no error handling around substituteMacroArgs() — missing required args would throw and crash the agent mid-execution. The fix wraps each step in try-catch and logs a helpful message with usage info. This pattern of catching runtime errors in slash command handlers and showing usage hints is worth standardizing.

The macro plugin's executeMacro calls sendUserMessage without an onEvent callback, so all ConversationEvent emissions (reasoning, toolCall, toolResult, assistantMessage) are lost. The event type is defined in conversation-service.ts, not in drone-core, so plugins can't type-check it — they must use a runtime type guard. Consider exporting ConversationEvent from drone-core so plugins can handle events properly.

The TUI's runSlashCommand returns early when a slash command is handled by the engine, without ever calling setIsLlmActive(true). This means any slash command that triggers LLM work (like a macro with chatPrompt steps) won't show the working indicator. The fix is to wrap the dispatchSlashCommand call in setIsLlmActive(true/false).

The ConversationEvent type is defined in conversation-service.ts but not exported from drone-core. Plugins that need to handle events from sendUserMessage must use a runtime type guard (event as { kind?: string; ... }) instead of proper TypeScript types. Consider exporting ConversationEvent from drone-core for type-safe plugin event handling.

When planning distributed systems like the drone swarm, specifically addressing the ' la trace' (event-log) pattern vs. a simple 'state' pattern early on allows for much better support of later features like knowledge distillation and real-time monitoring.
